_comment: Extended VO speaker → voice mapping. Consumed by the four extended-surface generators (banks / romance / encounters / awakening-overlay). New speakers added here are picked up automatically; existing per-character voice ids are duplicated from the python generators / first-meet config so a single source of truth covers the whole pipeline.

the_oracle.direction: Pre-rite Wraith → post-rite Hierophant; voice that has been heard underneath others'.

wraith_calder.direction: The Hierophant; written, near-silent, weight in pauses.

adjudicator_locke.direction: Authority's auditor — clipped legal cadence, weighing every word.

vex_solene.direction: Maestro of Coda's commerce — market-as-music, conducting cadence.

the_game_master.direction: Theatrical, public-address gravitas; performing for the room.

the_degen.direction: Casino-floor charm with a gambler's edge; nothing is ever serious.

nilmorg.direction: DMC Trench commentator — broadcast register flips to one-on-one mid-line.

the_antiquarian.direction: Citation cadence — desks do not run; he speaks like a footnote.

jericho_jones.direction: Laconic gunfighter with occasional theological surprises; long pauses, the line after the silence is the real one.

drael_mon.direction: We-already-own-you register — quiet certainty, never raises.

elara.direction: Warm, lucid, audible breath at line ends.

antiquarian.direction: Citation cadence — desks do not run; he speaks like a footnote.

source.direction: Theological present-tense; permeable phrases. 'You are' more than 'you will be'.

kael_trace.direction: Half a register lower than Source. Memory of being a person leaks through; rare and precious.

hierarchy:master_of_rlyeh.direction: Archival, wet, never raises. Inventories at four in the morning to a room that has not asked for the reading.

hierarchy:pale_emissary.direction: Patient to the point of menace. Polite, unhurried; presents rather than asks.

hierarchy:reckoning_daughter.direction: Meticulous, warm — warmth of finding correctness comforting. Pauses before each numerical figure; the pause is the discipline.

malkia_ukweli.direction: Declarative, present-tense; never uses 'should' (replaces with 'will' or 'do').

architect.direction: Cold, technically beautiful, bureaucratic. Specs first, address never. Predestination cadence — speaks from after the outcome. 'Begin.' rather than 'Good luck.'

dreamer.direction: Drowsy, kind, half-hummed. Brightens the instant she catches the player listening. Forbidden register: wise. Sometimes a phrase, sometimes a single word, sometimes a hum.
